readings.Aries: Not everyone processes at your speed. Today, your patience is more powerful than your pace. Saying less will move this further than saying more.
readings.Taurus: Something is asking you to change. Your resistance is understandable. It is also, right now, the problem. The first instinct was right.
readings.Gemini: You are in the middle of two things you haven't admitted are contradictory. They are. Go back to the original intention — it's still the right one.
readings.Cancer: The tide moves regardless of whether you're watching. What you feel today will shift. Let it. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.
readings.Leo: You've been waiting for permission to be as remarkable as you already are. This is the permission. Sleep on it before committing.
readings.Virgo: The system you've built is working. You are allowed to stop improving it for one day. Small, deliberate, and patient — that's the mode today.
readings.Libra: Something you've been weighing can only be decided by feeling, not analysis. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.
readings.Scorpio: The thing you're afraid of knowing is probably already known to some part of you. Someone you haven't thought of lately is relevant to this.
readings.Sagittarius: What you're searching for is real. It is also closer than the direction you're searching in. Small, deliberate, and patient — that's the mode today.
readings.Capricorn: The legacy you're building is real. Make sure it looks the way you actually want it to look. There's more support available than you've asked for.
readings.Aquarius: You have been right about this for a long time. It is not yet time to say 'I told you so.' The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Pisces: The current is strong today. You can swim with it and choose your direction within it. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
